notes_for_editor: Thin evidence: one state-division listing (via the Eastern US Lookouts page), one OpenStreetMap node and the tnlandforms list. No staffing, fire, fate or current-status source was read. The Waymarking page (JavaScript-only, returned just its title) and anyplaceamerica (403) gave nothing citable; a search snippet describes a 100-foot Aermotor north of Richlands, but that is unverified and not used. The 1936 steel tower may or may not be the tower mapped today; no source links them. Status and access left out as unknown.
